reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer (packet-only: competency text + rendered samples, no generator source), 2026-07-27 re-review batch

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency verbs are 'illustrate and apply properties', but no sampled item asks the pupil to demonstrate or use a property. Seed 43 simply asks 'What is 2 x 0?' and seed 44 asks '2 x 1 = ___' - these are bare product recalls; nothing asks whether 7 x 8 equals 8 x 7, or to regroup, or to distribute.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Five properties are named. Only the zero property (seeds 42, 43, 45, 46) and the identity property (seed 44) appear, and both only implicitly. The commutative property, the associative regrouping property, and the distributive property over a sum of two addends have zero generated samples in this packet.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Seed 45 offers option D with value -1 and text '-1' as a distractor for '6 x 0 = ___'; a Grade 3 pupil in Quarter 3 has never met a number below zero, so this option is unreadable to the intended learner. The remaining items also under-shoot, demanding single-digit zero recall rather than property reasoning.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: No structural variety exists for property work: there is no true/false judgement, no 'which property is shown' item, no equation-pair comparison, and no distributive form such as 6 x (4 + 3) = 6 x 4 + 6 x 3. Seeds 42 and 46 even repeat the same stem 'What is 3 x 0?'.

competency_alignment.rationale: The five items generated here are identical, item for item and option for option, to those generated for the sibling node mat_g3_na_q3_0 (same seeds 42-46, same stems, same keys). Two distinct competencies producing the same content is direct evidence the generator is not keyed to this node's property focus.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Illustrating properties on the 6-9 tables needs factors drawn from 6 through 9 and triples for the associative case. The largest number appearing in any stem is 6 ('6 x 0 = ___', seed 45), no item has three factors, and no sum of two addends is present for the distributive case.
